scope: Proposition 10.2 (Class and chamber of the auxiliary form) of the manuscript “Deforming hypersymplectic four-manifolds to hyperkähler triples” (preprints/Deforming-hypersymplectic-four-manifolds-to-hyperkahler-triples-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 341 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 92c36602fb496808), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a norm on the finite-dimensional space V . The forms of Theorem 10.1 can be chosen so that [Dε] = λεF + εuε, uε ∈ V, ∥uε∥ ≤ K, uεF ≥ a0 > 0, c0ε−1 ≤ λε ≤ c1ε−1 , (10.3) for fixed positive constants and all sufficiently small ε. Moreover [Dε] and [B] belong to the same component of the positive cone of V . There is a single sufficiently small choice of ε with the following property. For every definite closed pair with periods [A], [C], with either associated almost-complex sign, and every irreducible closed curve for that structure with class d ∈ H2(X; Z)/torsion, (10.4) [Dε]d > 0 =⇒ [B]d > 0. The choice depends only on the prepared construction and its period data, and is independent of the later pair or curve.
